name: Global Capital Markets Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Global Capital Markets Ltd is in the business of Finance and Investments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
a) GCML is registered as a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company. 
b) It invests in shares and securities and provides loans. 
c) It does trading /investment activities in Equity and FNO Segment and also trading in Commodities market
d) The company invests in securities through its group co., M/s. GCM Securities Limited which is a member of NSE and BSE
e) It has expanded its activities into Real Estate and Software Sector.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.50 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 422 to 95.4 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.39% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.71% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
